description:
Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds quarkus-flyway + quarkus-jdbc-h2 (in-memory) on top
        of the bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Flyway panel light-up: the migration history read from
        the application's active io.quarkus.flyway.runtime.FlywayContainer beans by the QuarkusFlywayProvider is
        shaped by the shared engine FlywayService, and the panel is surfaced on
        GET /bootui/api/flyway/migrations. Kept separate from bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which
        deliberately has NO quarkus-flyway, so the capability gate keeps the flyway panel unavailable) so the
        flyway-present and flyway-absent paths are each proven in isolation — the same split used for the
        Cache-present/absent and SmallRye-Health-present/absent coverage.
